instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: How do recursive suffix-based methods extend a pattern?
questions.question_ar: كيف تمدد طرائق النمو التكراري المعتمدة على اللواحق النمط؟
options: using features with the strongest linear correlation
using items that frequently occur in its suffix
Stop before checking the projected database
using only the first item in every transaction
options_en: using features with the strongest linear correlation
using items that frequently occur in its suffix
Stop before checking the projected database
using only the first item in every transaction
options_ar: باستخدام الخصائص ذات أقوى ارتباط خطي
باستخدام العناصر التي تتكرر في لاحقته
التوقف قبل فحص قاعدة البيانات المسقطة
باستخدام العنصر الأول فقط في كل معاملة
questions.explanation: Recursive Suffix-Based Pattern Growth Methods are techniques used to discover frequent sequential patterns by extending an existing pattern step by step using items that frequently occur in its suffix.
questions.explanation_ar: باستخدام العناصر التي تتكرر في لاحقته

questions.question: What mining task is commonly associated with recursive suffix-based pattern growth?
questions.question_ar: بأي مهمة تنقيب يرتبط نمو الأنماط باللواحق التكرارية عادة؟
options: commonly associated with categorical classification only
commonly associated with statistical feature selection
every possible transaction regardless of the pattern
commonly associated with sequential pattern mining
options_en: commonly associated with categorical classification only
commonly associated with statistical feature selection
every possible transaction regardless of the pattern
commonly associated with sequential pattern mining
options_ar: كل معاملة ممكنة بصرف النظر عن النمط
questions.explanation: This approach is commonly associated with sequential pattern mining, rather than traditional transaction-based association rule mining.

questions.question: What does a projected database contain for a particular pattern?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تحتوي قاعدة البيانات المسقطة لنمط معين؟
options: the relevant suffixes of sequences where that pattern occurs
all candidate itemsets in descending frequency order
commonly associated with transaction-based association rules
using all possible itemsets regardless of support
options_en: the relevant suffixes of sequences where that pattern occurs
all candidate itemsets in descending frequency order
commonly associated with transaction-based association rules
using all possible itemsets regardless of support
options_ar: اللواحق ذات الصلة من التسلسلات التي يظهر فيها ذلك النمط
كل مجموعات العناصر المرشحة بترتيب تكرار تنازلي
يرتبط عادة بقواعد الارتباط المعتمدة على المعاملات
باستخدام كل مجموعات العناصر الممكنة بصرف النظر عن الدعم
questions.explanation: For a particular pattern, we create a smaller database containing the relevant suffixes of sequences where that pattern occurs.
questions.explanation_ar: اللواحق ذات الصلة من التسلسلات التي يظهر فيها ذلك النمط

questions.question: What does the method do after extending the current pattern?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تفعل الطريقة بعد تمديد النمط الحالي؟
options: Focuses mainly on co-occurrence.
the minimum-support threshold
Recursively repeat the process
Remove every frequent single item
options_en: Focuses mainly on co-occurrence.
the minimum-support threshold
Recursively repeat the process
Remove every frequent single item

options: when support becomes equal to confidence
Focuses mainly on model performance.
when no frequent extension remains
when the first itemset is generated

when no frequent extension remains
when the first itemset is generated
